name: Research Labs

orgs.name: Allen Institute for AI
orgs.note: Ai2 (the Allen Institute for AI) describes itself as a non-profit AI research institute founded in 2014 by Paul G. Allen; source URL verified 2026-08-14

blurb: Frontier and industrial research labs, with parent organisation, leadership, funding model, and published work.

reading.body:
Research labs are organizational units conducting frontier or industrial AI work, though this data covers only one entity and thus cannot characterize the category's scale or diversity.

The Allen Institute for AI stands as a non-profit model for AI research, distinct from the venture-backed and corporate labs that dominate frontier development. Its founding in 2014 by a technology billionaire represents one path to sustained research capacity outside traditional academic and industry structures. The institute's self-description emphasizes independence, though the data does not specify its funding sources beyond the founding relationship, its annual operating budget, or whether it operates specialized computing facilities.

This entry documents organizational form rather than capabilities, infrastructure, or output. It does not reveal how research labs relate to the compute, buildings, or power systems that constrain AI scaling. Whether non-profit labs operate their own data centers, purchase capacity from cloud providers, or depend on university infrastructure remains outside the scope here. The single example also cannot show whether non-profit research institutions represent a growing or shrinking share of frontier AI work.
